title: Flock transparency-portal Prohibited Uses snapshot + 5 audit-log Reason fields
summary: Two-item request. Item 1 asks for a screenshot, printout, or export of the "Prohibited Uses" section of the Department's Flock Safety transparency portal as it currently appears. Item 2 asks for the audit log entry — including the Reason field — for five specific ALPR searches identified by record ID and date (four on 3/4–3/5/2026, one on 2/26/2026).
filed_because: Snapshots the Department's public-facing Prohibited Uses language at a point in time (useful against later silent edits) and pulls the underlying Reason-field content for a small, specific set of searches for cross-checking.
notes:
Filed 2026-09-14. Closed 2026-09-21 (Kelly O'Keefe). Item 1 (Prohibited Uses snapshot): "no responsive records" — the Department states "The Flock Safety transparency portal is maintained by Flock Safety. The Department does not maintain a separate screenshot, printout, or export of the 'Prohibited Uses' section outside of the information available on the portal." Item 2 (five specific audit-log Reason fields): folded into the rolling W012541-041426 production, not answered directly.

Item 1's disclaimer is in tension with other Department PRA responses that call the same portal "our transparency portal" / "our internal search history which has been made publicly available" when citing it to satisfy other requests (W013137-072926, W013260-081726, W013271-081926, W013305-082426) — same signer (Kelly O'Keefe) on both W013260 (2026-08-26, "our...portal") and this letter (2026-09-21, "maintained by Flock Safety").
